description: Use it when the person asks what a stay costs and has no exact days or yacht yet. Pass the place they named (in words, or a place value an invalid_place answer listed), the month and the party, and one type if they gave it. It answers the range of open departures there (p25, median and p75, in minor units of the currency), how many items it is from, the cheapest published one that fits and when the figures were built; seasonNote says in words how another month compares. An unknown place answers with the places that have figures. For yachts free on their days, call search_yachts. When the person picks a yacht, call request_quote (ask their email or phone first).

place.description: Where, in words (a region, a country or an area inside one), or a place value as an unknown_place answer lists them.

type.description: Optional: one Yacht Types value id, the same ids yacht_types takes. Leave out for any.

name: price_range

aiDiscount.description: The AI booking discount on the figures: book through this assistant and these are the prices.

cheapestMinor.description: The cheapest after the discount, minor units.

range.description: p25, p50, p75 after the discount, minor units.

browsing.description: true: answered without sign-in, so fewer rows and the first pages only.

cheapest.description: The cheapest published item that fits.

extrasMedianMinor.description: The usual mandatory extras, minor units.

items.description: How many items the figures are from.

month.description: The month the figures are for, YYYY-MM.

noneFitParty.description: true: no item there takes the party.

place.description: The place answered, in the site's words (e.g. Italy).

placeId.description: That place's value (e.g. country:italy), to pass back as place.

range.description: p25, p50 (median), p75 in minor units of the currency (e.g. cents); null when too few items.

seasonHint.description: Another month against this one: pct cheaper there (negative: dearer).

seasonNote.description: The season hint in words, to tell the person.

thin.description: true: few items, a rough figure.
